items.title: Only / alone → None but · Nothing but · Nowhere but · not more than
items.body:
Only he can play good cricket. → None but he can play good cricket.
He is only four. → He is not more than four.
I gave him only a book. → I gave him nothing but a book.

items.title: must / can / have to → cannot but · cannot help + V- ing
items.body:
You must yield to your fate. → You cannot but yield to your fate.
You must care them. → You cannot help caring them.

items.title: Every / Everybody / All → There is no … but
items.body:
Everyone hates a terrorist. → There is no one but hates a terrorist.
Every man wants to be happy. → There is no man but wants to be happy.

items.title: As soon as → No sooner had … than
items.body: As soon as he saw the tiger, he ran away. → No sooner had he seen the Tiger than he ran away.

items.title: Always ↔ Never
items.body:
He was always punctual. → He was never late.
Always speak the truth. → Never tell a lie.
I always agreed with him. → I never disagreed with him.

items.title: as … as · less … than · more ↔ less
items.body:
He is as good as you. → He is not less good than you.
He is less ugly than you said. → He is not as ugly as you said.

items.title: Very / very much → not + বিপরীত শব্দ + at all
items.body: He is a very rich man. → He is not a poor man at all.

items.title: Superlative → No other … as … as
items.body: He is the tallest in the class. → No other is as tall as he.

items.title: সাধারণ নিয়ম — বিপরীত শব্দ বসিয়ে Negative করা
items.body:
He is a good man. → He is not a bad man.
Rakib is an honest boy. → Rakib is not a dishonest boy.
This was an extra-ordinary ship. → This was not an ordinary ship.

items.title: Negative → Affirmative (উল্টো Rule)
items.body:
(Gonit) He is not a bad man. → He is a good man.
Neg → Aff: I cannot but go there. → I must go there.

items.title: Affirmative → Negative Interrogative
items.body: She is a beautiful girl. → Isn't she a beautiful girl?

items.title: Negative → Affirmative Interrogative
items.body: She is not a beautiful girl. → Is she a beautiful girl?

items.title: Nothing / Never → Anything / Ever
items.body:
There was nothing to do. → Was there anything to do?
I never drink cold water. → Do I ever drink cold water?

items.title: Everybody / Everyone / All → Who + Negative
items.body: Everybody knows him. → Who does not know him?

items.title: Nobody / No one / None → Who + Affirmative
items.body: Nobody believes a liar. → Who believes a liar?

items.title: Assertive → Imperative (Let-গঠন)
items.body:
I must go now. → Let me go now.
He should not tell a lie. → Let him not tell a lie.

items.title: Imperative → Assertive (উল্টো)
items.body: Let's help the government in this regard. → We should help the government in this regard.

items.title: Assertive → Exclamatory (What / How)
items.body:
You are a great fool. → What a fool you are!
The bird is very nice. → How nice the bird is!

items.title: It is a matter of joy/sorrow/shame that … → Hurrah! / Alas! / Fie! / Wow!
items.body:
It is a matter of sorrow that the old man is no more. → Alas!
The old man is no more.

items.title: Exclamatory → Assertive (উল্টো)
items.body:
How nice the bird is! → The bird is very nice.
What a fool you are! → You are a great fool.

items.title: Interrogative (Rhetorical) → Assertive
items.body: Who does not like peace? → Everybody likes peace.

items.title: Superlative → Positive
items.body:
বইয়ের উদাহরণ: Della is the best housewife. → No other housewife is as good as Della.
Padma is one of the largest rivers in Bangladesh. → Very few rivers in Bangladesh are as large as Padma.

items.title: Superlative → Comparative
items.body:
বইয়ের উদাহরণ: It is the most significant event in the history of Bangladesh. → It is more significant than any other event in the history of Bangladesh.
Rakib is one of the biggest boys in the class. → Rakib is bigger than most other boys in the class.

items.title: Comparative → Positive
items.body:
বইয়ের উদাহরণ: A frugal man is happier than a prodigal man. → A prodigal man is not as happy as a frugal man.
Karim is better than Rahim. → Rahim is not as good as Karim.

items.title: Comparative → Superlative
items.body:
বইয়ের উদাহরণ: Feroza is more curious than all other women in the group. → Feroza is the most curious of all women in the group.
Akbar was greater than most other kings of India. → Akbar was one of the greatest kings of India.

items.title: Positive → Comparative
items.body:
বইয়ের উদাহরণ: Very few metals are as costly as gold. → Gold is costlier than most other metals.
Rahim is as good as Karim. → Karim is not better than Rahim.
Nepal is not as big as Bangladesh. → Bangladesh is bigger than Nepal.

items.title: Positive → Superlative
items.body:
বইয়ের উদাহরণ: Very few countries in the world are as poor as Bangladesh. → Bangladesh is one of the poorest countries in the world.
No other girl in the class is as tall as Sumi. → Sumi is the tallest girl in the class.

items.title: Assertive: Active → Passive
items.body:
They have played football. → Football has been played by them.
He is eating rice. → Rice is being eaten by him.
We must follow him. → He must be followed by us.

items.title: Interrogative: Active → Passive
items.body:
Does he read the book? → Is the book read by him?
Who broke the glass? → By whom was the glass broken?
Whom did he choose? → Who was chosen by him?

items.title: Passive → Active
items.body:
The report was made by Taksim. → Taksim made the report.
The sum has been done by Tuna. → Tuna has done the sum.
My pocket has been picked. → Someone has picked my pocket.

items.title: Though / Although ↔ In spite of ↔ but
items.body:
S: In spite of / despite
Cx: Though/although
Cd: PC + but + PC

items.title: As / Since / Because ↔ Because of ↔ and so
items.body: Because of / On account of / for / by → as / since / because → PC and so PC

items.title: If (affirmative) ↔ By + V-ing ↔ and
items.body:
S: By + V-ing
Cx: If + S + V (aff)
Cd: PC and PC

items.title: If … not / Unless ↔ Without + V-ing ↔ or
items.body:
S: Without + V-ing
Cx: If … (neg)
Cd: PC or PC

items.title: Too … to ↔ So … that … not ↔ Very … and so
items.body:
S: Enough…to
Cx: So…that (aff)
Cd: Very… and so (aff)

items.title: To / In order to ↔ So that ↔ and so
items.body:
S: To+V1/in order to+V1
Cx: So that
Cd: And so

items.title: Besides · While · Not only … but also
items.body:
Besides
While + S+V+O
not only … but also

items.title: Immediately after · On + V-ing ↔ As soon as ↔ and at once
items.body:
S: On hearing the news
Cx: As soon as
Cd: and at once

items.title: When · At the time of · Preposition + noun (সময়)
items.body: চার্ট: Preposition + Noun / At the time of / At the age of / After + V-ing → When → … and …

items.title: Relative Pronoun · Adjective · Participle · and
items.body: The pious are happy. ↔ Those who are pious are happy. ↔ They are pious and happy. Health is wealth. ↔ It is health which is wealth. ↔ It is health and wealth.

items.title: Noun clause · Noun phrase · বিবিধ (that-clause, What, It is…that, the reason why)
items.body:
(নিয়ম ১৬): S: Our freedom fighters showed dedication to their motherland.
Cx: What our freedom fighters showed was dedication
Cd: … showed something … and it was dedication
